courses.title: Agentic Engineering 101: Zero to Hero
courses.outcome: Direct, understand, provision, navigate, verify, and safely operate useful agent work.

modules.title: From chatbot to worker
modules.summary: See how the working environment changes context, capability, and the journey of an artefact.

modules.title: Give the cloud agent the project
modules.summary: Treat project access as a surface with its own state, representations, permissions, and blind spots.

modules.title: The project has a home
modules.summary: Persist important decisions beyond the conversation, then decide which durable source carries authority.

modules.title: Repositories, save points, and safe breakage
modules.summary: Judge the blast radius, inspect the diff, and preserve a recovery path before publishing change.

modules.title: Model, harness, context, tools, and behaviour
modules.summary: Diagnose the failing layer in the worker's system before changing it.

modules.title: What does the model know?
modules.summary: Test what the model retains, what evidence supplies, and whether missing recall proves anything.

modules.title: Tools, operating knowledge, and domain provisioning
modules.summary: Provision useful expertise while keeping verification and acceptance with the human.

modules.title: What did we just create? Local work and connected systems
modules.summary: Distinguish access, context, and discovery before trusting what an agent says it can find.

modules.title: Source of truth and verification
modules.summary: Identify what can be observed, which source governs, and what proves the result.

modules.title: Build a real agentic project
modules.summary: Take an owned goal from vague intent to an accepted, evidence-backed result.

courses.title: Advanced Agentic Engineering: Mastering Agents
courses.outcome: Design agent behaviour, workflow, context, delegation, evaluation, and autonomy.

modules.title: Agent self-introspection and local review
modules.summary: Use cheap prediction, self-review, and test-first probes before adding workflow machinery.

modules.title: Autonomous human-in-the-loop workflows
modules.summary: Turn repeated behaviour into explicit loops, gates, stop conditions, and human decisions.

modules.title: Specialist sub-agents and orchestration
modules.summary: Introduce specialist workers only when separation buys something material.

modules.title: Harnesses, portability, and agent observability
modules.summary: Compare the intended worker with the one the runtime actually creates and exposes.

modules.title: The 20-Agent Bonfire and context transport
modules.summary: Make the cost of over-delegation, transported context, defaults, and coordination painfully visible.

modules.title: Selective provisioning, context, and evaluation
modules.summary: Supply the right knowledge at the right scope, then test whether behaviour improved.

modules.title: Trust boundaries and connected autonomy
modules.summary: Bound connected autonomy by making authority, permission, and reach explicit.

modules.title: Concurrent agents and isolation
modules.summary: Earn isolation, reconciliation, and integration by letting capable workers collide over shared state.

modules.title: Retrospective: how this repo was built
modules.summary: Reconstruct and critique the agent system through its history, decisions, and evidence.

courses.title: Beyond the Agent: Engineering Agent Systems
courses.outcome: Design trust, coordination, concurrency, integration, provenance, and operational behaviour around agents.
